svg.aria-label: From a wanted movie to a file in the library: 1. State: The init-db container makes sure the radarr database and role exist on shared postgres-18-rw. Radarr keeps its settings in the radarr-config claim. 2. Search: Radarr asks the indexers that Prowlarr provides for each wanted movie, then ranks the releases by the Recyclarr scores. 3. Grab: The chosen NZB goes to SABnzbd, which downloads and repairs it on shared-downloads. 4. Import: Radarr copies the finished file from /data/downloads into /data/nas-media. NFS and CephFS cannot hardlink, so every import is a copy. 5. Back up: kopiur snapshots radarr-config to Ceph every four hours and to R2 at 11:00 New York time, daily.
